title: Promise and Waiting Path
purpose: Help children retell promise, waiting, fulfilment, and joy in order.
body_markdown:
# Promise and Waiting Path

Cut out or point to four boxes:

1. God promises Sarah a son.
2. Abraham and Sarah wait.
3. Isaac is born.
4. Sarah rejoices.

## Teacher note

This is one specific covenant promise. Do not turn it into a guarantee about every family request.
